full_judgment: 3. The defendant-petitioners contested the suit by filing written statement. The case of the defendants is that the land in question belongs to the Government and the same was properly recorded as khas land in both SA record as well as RS record. The plaintiff fraudulently obtained ex parte decree in Miscellaneous Case No. 21 of 1973 and the defendant filed another Title Suit being Title Suit No.151 of 1975 and obtained a decree to the effect that the judgment and decree passed in Miscelaneous Case No.21 of 1973 is not binding upon the defendant-petitioner. Further case of the defendant is that the land in question is a channel as per section 20(2A) of the SAT Act, 1950 and, as such, the suit land is retainable by the Government and the plain- tiff has miserably failed to prove his possession and the documents as adduced by the plaintiff are forged, collusive and illegal.
